title: Quaint Umami Korean Tofu Sujebi
description: A traditional Korean dish featuring lacto-vegetarian friendly tofu and umami flavors, this sujebi recipe combines the best of Korean cuisine with a hint of Japanese shichimi-togarashi spice

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together wheat flour and salt, then gradually add water to form a dough, kneading for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll each into a ball, then flatten slightly into a disk shape
In a large pan, heat vegetable oil over medium heat and sauté the onion and garlic until softened
Add the cubed tofu, shichimi-togarashi, and korean chili flakes, stirring to combine
Add the sliced korean zucchini and cook until tender
In a large pot, bring the vegetable broth to a boil, then add the tofu and zucchini mixture
Add the sujebi dough disks to the pot and cook for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface
Season with salt to taste, then serve hot
